summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2K.3 executed the single real-effect node authorized by 149O.20L.7O.2K.2's report: creation (create-only) of one current HMIC CertificationRecord via scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py create against the already source-parity-restored hac-dell deployment (305f8e7913bac76941dade6ff4e018c74533f062). Source freshness was revalidated fresh rather than trusted from the prior phase report: git diff --name-status 305f8e79..origin/main (7 commits) classified every changed path and found only non-authority-bearing governance/documentation artifacts (.pcae/authority-evaluation, .pcae/decision-sessions, .pcae/publication-execution, phase-completion metadata/report, CHANGELOG, PROJECT_STATUS, task files, one docs file, one tests file) -- none intersecting the 36 HMIC frozen files, the 7 bound contracts, or any deployment/certification production code. This was independently corroborated (not just git-diff-inferred) by re-running derive_implementation_scope_digest and derive_contract_versions on the Mac working tree at current HEAD (03b51f12) and confirming byte-identical results to the same derivation run live on Dell against 305f8e79. Fresh host identity (hostname atila-Latitude-E5470, machine-id 54ff22ce400b475aa0d55cb68f4a3334, RepositoryIdentity 0107866f-af7c-40b4-8317-74e71acb05ca), fresh deployment source cleanliness (git HEAD 305f8e79, clean, 4402 tracked paths, zero drift), and fresh Protected Root compliance (/etc/pcae/hatp/trust-store, root:pcae 0750, safe ancestor chain) were all reconfirmed read-only before mutation. Pre-mutation protected state was confirmed absent through the production validator (MISSING status) rather than raw file-listing alone. The verification-record locator was resolved to docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7O_2H_3_HMIC_PATHS_SOURCE_SCOPE_AND_SEVEN_CONTRACT_CONSISTENCY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md -- the exact 149O.19-class independent-verification phase report for the current HMIC-001 v1.6 bound-contract set ('VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- HMIC-001 v1.6 REPAIR COMPLETE'), confirmed byte-identical on Mac and Dell (sha256 b49cabe271...). A genuine Protected Admin Authority election and human confirmation were obtained in-chat immediately before invocation: the full precomputed target tuple (repository_instance_id, canonical_deployment_root, implementation_commit, implementation_scope_digest, contract_versions, verification_record_path/digest) was presented to the human, who reviewed it and supplied certified_by="Atila Madai" themselves -- not inferred from any prior approval, not fabricated. The ceremony was invoked via SSH as root (sudo -n, since only root has real write access to the Protected Root under codex's non-pcae-group login) against the deployed venv: scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py create --repository-root /opt/pcae/runtime/src --certified-by "Atila Madai" --verification-record-path <the resolved locator> --assume-yes (the confirmation gate already having been satisfied genuinely in-chat at the ceremony boundary; --assume-yes only skips the redundant stdin re-prompt over a non-interactive SSH exec). Result: certification_id=2e5f861249d8e70bff53ba2f371d84e37e14eff0bbfcd939902fa7b47d236bd7, already_existed=False. Immediate post-write verification through load_certification() (the production reader) confirmed every field matches the precomputed target exactly, and certifications.json contains exactly one record. certification-bindings.json remains absent (no active binding was written). The production validator remains MISSING, and certification_status_satisfies_readiness(MISSING) is False -- readiness was never wired or flipped; this is the validator's own dynamic re-derivation, not a hardcoded ceiling. No cutover/activation artifact exists anywhere under /etc/pcae -- HATP remains not active. The Class-B diagnostic, re-run under the exact established precedent invocation recovered from 149O.20L.7D.11's report (sudo -u pcae, clean env -i, verify_class_b_deployment_conformance() with no repository-root override -- an initial, non-precedent uid=0 sudo -n probe produced a spurious wider failure set purely from agent/admin-co-mingling checks tripping under root and was discarded), returned NON_COMPLIANT with the sole residual HBDC-REQ-042 (DeploymentBinding absent) -- exactly the expected pre-DeploymentBinding residual, 32/33 other checks satisfied. Wider /etc/pcae searches before and after confirmed HardwareCredentialRecord, Principal, Signer, and DeploymentBinding all remain absent; Dell git HEAD remained 305f8e79 throughout (no redeployment); Protected Root ownership/mode/ACL/ancestor-chain unchanged (only new files created inside the existing directory by the ceremony itself: .certification-transition.lock, certifications.json). Phase-local disposable testing (an ad hoc tempfile-rooted script plus a committed 6-test suite) exercised the create-only writer's confirm-declined/confirm-accepted paths, exact-byte-identical-replay idempotency, and activate-on-unknown-id fail-closed behavior, all against a disposable protected root -- never the real Dell trust-store. fast_green was run once on the phase tree and once on an isolated git worktree pinned to the phase-entry commit (identical source, since this phase made no src/scripts/contract changes); a first concurrent dual-run produced shared-real-audit-directory interference in tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence (resolved by a clean solo re-run). Solo-run classification: both baseline and phase tree returned 332 failed / 8337 passed / 4 skipped / 9 errors -- identical counts, with the failing node sets differing by exactly one substitution: a new false-positive keyword collision (a historical phase's own git-status-substring guard tripping on this phase's own task-file name containing "certification", not a code regression) replacing the transient audit-directory flake. Zero attributable regressions.
